docs.summary: Blows particles around. The wind a particle feels is a steady [`AmbientWind`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.ParticleSystem.Modules.WindModule~AmbientWind), plus the nearest [`WindZone`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.WindZone), plus a swirling turbulence layer. The zone is picked once per frame from the system's position, everything else is sampled per particle.
Steady world space wind that blows everywhere, with or without a wind zone.
Scales the whole wind velocity this system feels.

How quickly particles are carried along by the wind, per second. Higher values make light debris that rides the air, 0 makes particles ignore it. Since still air is still wind, this also settles particles that are moving through calm space.
Extra straight acceleration along the wind. Use for gusty, arcade feeling pushes.
Speed of the swirls layered on top of the wind, in units per second.
World size of one swirl. Larger values give broader, lazier eddies.
How fast the swirl pattern drifts through the world.
The zone this module is currently pulling wind from, if any.
